Excel is a MIGRATION SOURCE, not a backend
— continue the tree to pick the real store

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Need ANY of: auditing · field-level/hierarchical security · business units · CMK ·
plug-ins · multi-environment managed-solution ALM ·
a surface beyond Teams (Power Pages / model-driven / Dynamics 365)?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Dataverse (full)
— only it offers these

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Is the data RELATIONAL (real relationships, lookups, business rules)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Volume + write pattern within SharePoint's healthy range?
(lightweight tracking, not a high-write transactional app)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Microsoft Lists / SharePoint
(flat data, Teams/Lists/custom-code surface)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Dataverse (full)
— SharePoint is not a transactional DB at scale

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Teams-scoped app, < ~1M rows, no premium license,
one unmanaged solution per env acceptable?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Dataverse for Teams
(relational, Teams-only, included w/ qualifying M365+Teams)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Dataverse (full)
— scale / licensing / ALM / surface exceeds for-Teams
